title: Replace a registration renewal notice
summary: You can order a replacement registration renewal notice online if you have misplaced or lost your original notice.
intro:
If you've misplaced or lost your renewal notice and you'd like a replacement notice, you can order one online.

Note that you can get your vehicle's billing number when renewing your registration online.
who_can_apply: Must be recorded as the owner of the registered vehicle.
what_you_need: The last 4 digits of your VIN (found on your rego papers or on your vehicle)

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to replace your registration renewal notice.

more_info.text: You can opt in to Digital Vehicle Registration to receive your registration renewal notice by email, and in your MyServiceNSW Account and the Service NSW app.

faqs.q: Who can apply for a replacement renewal notice?
faqs.a: You must be recorded as the owner of the registered vehicle to get a copy of the renewal notice.

faqs.q: What do I need to replace my renewal notice online?
faqs.a: You need your NSW Driver Licence details, the vehicle's plate number, and the last 4 digits of your VIN.

faqs.q: How do I get a replacement notice?
faqs.a: Select the 'Replace online' button and follow the prompts to replace your registration renewal notice.
